question: Who has the right to appoint an inter-state council to promote centre-state and inter-state cooperation?

options.text: Both the President and Governor together
Both the Prime Minister and Chief Minister together

solution:
The correct answer is__** the President of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The President of India **has the right to appoint an inter-state council to promote centre-state and inter-state cooperation.
 
• The nation can progress only if the **Union and State Governments** work hand in hand.
 
• **Inter-State Council** is not a permanent constitutional body, which can be created at any time if it seems to the** President **that the public interest would be served by the establishment of such a council. 
 
• It was set up in **1990** through a presidential ordinance for the first time as per the recommendations of the **Sarkaria Commission **under the Ministry of Home affairs.
 
• The secretarial functions of the Zonal Councils have been reassigned to the** Inter-State Council Secretariat** from** 1st April 2011**.
 
• Inter-State Council works as an instrument for** cooperation, coordination and the evolution of common policies**. 
 
• The interstate council is proposed to meet **thrice** a year. But in **26 years**, it has met only **11 times**. The latest meeting was held after a gap of **10 years** in Delhi in July **2016**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Droupadi** **Murmu** is an Indian politician who is the **15th** and current President of India since 25 July 2022. 
 
• She is a member of the **Bharatiya Janata Party**. 
 
• She is the **first** person belonging to the **tribal** community and also the **second** woman after **Pratibha Patil** to hold the President's office.
